reserves.name: Re7-managed DeFi yield strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Re7 Capital strategy manager and Midas issuer

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: mRe7YIELD is a liquid yield token certificate tracking a Re7 Capital managed DeFi yield strategy (lending, liquidity provisioning, restaking, funding-rate arbitrage, and options) rather than a claim on one stablecoin. The slice name is aligned to the exact live chainlink-nav adapter row identity so the reviewed classification overlays the captured NAV exposure; public sources identify the strategy mandate and attestation framework, but do not provide a durable position-level composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Midas product, risk, and attestation disclosures; live NAV row identity from the Midas Chainlink NAV oracle adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The managed strategy's position-level assets, venues, and weights are not disclosed in a durable static composition.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The strategy mandate is known, but current position-level stablecoin, protocol, and venue exposures are not available for reviewed links.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Fordefi documents dedicated Midas workspaces in which the strategy manager holds an MPC share and Midas holds an administrative policy share. Assets are actively deployed across protocols and venues, so provider allocation, venue segregation, and reuse conditions remain strategy-dependent.
